chokepoints.name: Korea Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Links East China Sea with Sea of Japan; connects major Korean & Japanese industrial ports.

chokepoints.name: Taiwan Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: High-density container & bulk route connecting Northeast Asia to global trade lanes.

chokepoints.name: Malacca Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Main shipping channel between Indian Ocean and Pacific; world's busiest commodity conveyor belt.

chokepoints.name: Dover Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Busiest shipping passage in Europe; links North Sea and Baltic to Atlantic Ocean.

chokepoints.name: Bohai Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Feeder gateway for Tianjin, Tangshan (Caofeidian/Jingtang), and Qinhuangdao coal/ore ports.

chokepoints.name: Gibraltar Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Sole natural outlet from Mediterranean Sea to Atlantic Ocean.

chokepoints.name: Luzon Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Connects Philippine Sea with South China Sea; primary trans-Pacific container funnel.

chokepoints.name: Cape of Good Hope
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Primary global circumnavigation alternative to Suez and Bab el-Mandeb reroutings.

chokepoints.name: Bosporus Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Vital outlet for Black Sea grain, Russian oil, and Ukrainian agribulk exports.

chokepoints.name: Tsugaru Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Connects Sea of Japan to open Pacific; international passage for US-East Asia routes.
chokepoints.rerouting_via: La Perouse Strait or south of Honshu

chokepoints.name: Makassar Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Major north-south thoroughfare linking Lombok Strait to Celebes Sea.

chokepoints.name: Mindoro Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Alternative Philippine corridor connecting to Sulu Sea.

chokepoints.name: Yucatan Channel
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Entryway to Gulf of Mexico from Caribbean for US Gulf crude, LNG, and grain exports.

chokepoints.name: Oresund Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Danish straits gateway connecting Baltic Sea oil and fertilizer hubs to North Sea.

chokepoints.name: Suez Canal
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Artery connecting Mediterranean to Red Sea; handles ~12% of global seaborne commerce.

chokepoints.name: Lombok Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Deep-water alternative to Malacca for Capesize iron ore carriers (Australia-China/Japan).

chokepoints.name: Sunda Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Secondary Indonesian passage connecting Indian Ocean to Java Sea.

chokepoints.name: Panama Canal
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Connects Atlantic and Pacific; critical for US Gulf grain, LNG/LPG to Asia, and container flows.
chokepoints.rerouting_via: Suez / Cape of Good Hope or Magellan

chokepoints.name: Bab el-Mandeb Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Connects Gulf of Aden and Red Sea; gatekeeper to Suez Canal for Asia-Europe trade.

chokepoints.name: Windward Passage
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Direct navigational approach between US East Coast and Panama Canal.

chokepoints.name: Balabac Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: South China Sea to Sulu Sea link.

chokepoints.name: Mona Passage
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Key channel between Atlantic and Caribbean for Europe-Panama trade.

chokepoints.name: Kerch Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Access corridor to Sea of Azov Russian/Ukrainian grain & coal export berths.

chokepoints.name: Ombai Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Deep-water Indonesian passage between Banda Sea and Savu Sea.

chokepoints.name: Torres Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Passage between Australia and Papua New Guinea; navigationally constrained reef waters.

chokepoints.name: Magellan Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Southern cone passage connecting Atlantic and Pacific; bypass for Capesize/VLCCs unable to transit Panama.

chokepoints.name: Strait of Hormuz
chokepoints.strategic_importance: World's most critical oil transit chokepoint; carries ~21M bpd (21% of global petroleum consumption).
chokepoints.rerouting_via: East-West Crude Pipeline / None for LNG

chokepoints.name: Bering Strait
chokepoints.strategic_importance: Northern Sea Route (NSR) terminus linking Arctic Ocean with Pacific; seasonal ice-class voyages.
